family_title_en: Complete the word with the correct vowel team

stages.ix_title: Complete the word with the correct vowel team

prompt.en: Which vowel team completes the word?

what_to_do.en: Tap the vowel team that completes the word.

stages.choice_rule: Four vowel-team choices in shuffled order. Use only ai, ay, ea, ee, ie, oa, oe, oo, ou, ow, oi, oy, au, aw, ew, ue, or igh. Exactly one team replaces the hyphen and spells the word the sentence means. No whole words, no single letters, and no sound marks.

gold_items.stem: Wet drops from the sky are r-n.
The night sky has a m-n.
We swim at the sandy b-ch.
Mom has a warm c-t in the snow.
A farm animal with soft wool is a sh-p.
A fun ride on the lake is a b-t.
<NAME> ate hot m-t for dinner at home.

roots: Choices are vowel teams of two or three letters, never whole words and never a single letter.
Exactly one choice fills the hyphen so the sentence names one real word.
Keep teams inside this set: ai, ay, ea, ee, ie, oa, oe, oo, ou, ow, oi, oy, au, aw, ew, ue, igh.
On tier 1, each wrong team must form a non-word in that gap.
On tier 2, one wrong team is a common mix-up, such as ee beside ea or ow beside oa.
On tier 3, at least two teams must form real words, and only the sentence picks one.
Do not put the finished word in the stem. Do not use slash marks, held sounds, or real names.
Stay in a kid world of school, home, food, pets, play, family, or weather. No brands.

tier_rules.1: Clues of four to seven words with one hyphen gap. Use a common team such as ai, ee, oa, oo, or ow. Each wrong team must spell a non-word. A media lemma of the finished word is allowed.
tier_rules.2: Clues of five to nine words. A two-syllable word is welcome. One wrong team is a close mix-up, such as ee beside ea or oo beside oa. Do not add a picture lemma.
tier_rules.3: Clues of seven to ten words. At least two teams must spell real words, so only the sentence meaning can decide. Use explain_key use_sentence. Do not add a picture lemma.
